title: KubeSense system dashboard
description: One dashboard file in this repository: the envelope (name, description, meta) around a dashboard preset. This schema checks the envelope and meta only. kubeapi's validator checks the preset.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, so editors offer autocomplete. The loader ignores it.

name.description: Dashboard title shown in KubeSense. Renaming it is fine.

description.description: Short text shown under the title.

preset.description: The dashboard preset, as an object (preferred) or as the JSON string that Export writes. Not checked here; kubeapi's validator checks it.

meta.title: Dashboard meta
meta.description: Identity, version and install requirements of the dashboard.

key.description: Permanent identity of the dashboard. Never change it. Renaming the dashboard or moving the file is fine.

version.description: Starts at 1. Raise it whenever the dashboard changes, otherwise the API keeps the old copy.

requires.description: When the dashboard is copied into an install and shown. Omit it to show the dashboard everywhere.

retired.description: Set to true, and raise version, to remove the dashboard. Deleting the file does nothing.

match.description: any: one condition is enough. all: every condition must hold.

conditions.description: What to check on the install. Each condition has exactly one key.

condition.description: One check with exactly one key: env, integration, rum or metric.

env.description: kubernetes, or legacy for virtual machine hosts (met when VM host metrics were seen in the last 7 days). docker is reserved and not supported yet.

integration.description: Met while an account is connected for that integration. synthetics is met while the install runs the Synthetics gateway.

rum.description: Met once an application of that type exists.

metric.description: A MetricsQL series selector, with labels if needed. Met when it had any sample in the last 7 days. This schema cannot parse MetricsQL; kubeapi's validator does.
